name: Confirm this customer's number can send SMS
description: Blocked entirely until their 10DLC campaign is approved - see 06_signalwire_10dlc_registration.csv if that hasn't happened yet. Don't promise SMS works before checking this.

name: If the customer wants their own API access: issue a token
description: "Issue Customer Access Token" gives them independently-usable SignalWire credentials scoped to their own subproject, without ever exposing your own project's auth_token.

name: Send the customer their token and a brief integration pointer
description: Confirm they understand it's scoped to their subproject only, and how to revoke/reissue it themselves if needed.

name: Confirm inbound SMS logs correctly
description: Send a real test text to their number and confirm it shows up logged to the matched contact's chatter (or unmatched, if no contact exists yet).

name: If webhook forwarding into the customer's own system is wanted
description: Confirm their forwarding URL is configured and actually receiving the webhook payload, not just saved in the field.
